title: Ask before treating a hypothetical preference as prediction intent
request: Continue from the failed task-planning comparison by fixing the shared routing defect and identifying the next permitted integration slice.
spec: Targeted Home intent correction following engineering/planning/TP_06.txt; rollout boundary from TP_07.txt.
plan: Reproduce the generic English false prediction signal on independently written questions.
Remove hypothetical would as sufficient evidence and version the changed rule.
Check prediction, model-first, confirmed-choice and Home integration behavior with focused offline tests.
Review the correction, preserve frozen evaluations and record the next developer-preview boundary.

decisions.decision: Remove only the bare hypothetical would alternative from the predictive signal.
decisions.why: A question about choosing a deliverable does not specify an unknown outcome; the existing clarification path already handles missing intent.

decisions.decision: Retain explicit model requests, future signals, outcome-word fallback and validated model readings.
decisions.why: The correction should remove an unsupported inference without introducing another router or requiring a model for every request.

decisions.decision: Keep all confirmed user choices authoritative.
decisions.why: A wording correction must not reinterpret an explicit choice as a request for another track.

decisions.decision: Leave all frozen benchmark cases, thresholds and results unchanged.
decisions.why: A targeted regression repair is not an unseen model or release evaluation.

change: Version the Home rule as intent_rules_v6 and remove would alone as sufficient evidence from which_will. Add six focused test methods covering clarification, real predictions, model reading, Home safety, explicit choices and unresolved track answers. Document the next read-only developer preview without enabling execution.

findings.defect: The fallback rules treated a hypothetical preference about the desired deliverable as a stated prediction task.
findings.scenario: A person asks which deliverable would help, and Home selects prediction instead of asking what help they need. A valid analysis model reading also gets a spurious prediction conflict.
findings.cause: The which_will regular expression accepted would after any one- or two-word subject without requiring prediction evidence.
findings.fix: Remove would as sufficient evidence, retain other predictive signals and let the existing open-question or validated-model path decide.
findings.test: Three new regression methods reproduced the old behavior. After the fix, all 109 relevant application tests pass, including six new methods.

findings.defect: A rejected promotion recommendation was described as blocking all work on the next UI package.
findings.scenario: The next package explicitly permits a developer-only read-only preview while execution gates remain failed.
findings.cause: The earlier handoff did not distinguish preview implementation from enabling execution.
findings.fix: Record developer-preview visibility as the next permitted slice while preserving the rejected execution recommendation and model integration gap.
findings.test: Inspected the TP-07 backend and rollout rules; no execution switch or permission change is included.

measurements.name: Relevant routing checks
measurements.gate: All 109 distinct relevant application tests must pass, with no skips or live model calls.
measurements.result: 109 tests passed without skips: 50 Home intent checks and 59 related language, conversation, routing and selected chip/workflow integration checks. Six test methods are new.
limits: These are offline regression cases, not a new frozen benchmark or a general model-quality measurement.

measurements.name: Independent review
measurements.gate: An independent reviewer must identify no remaining correctness finding after checking the diff and explicit-choice/model precedence.
measurements.result: Independent review passed with no correctness finding.

measurements.name: Development record checks
measurements.gate: The generated development corpus must have zero refused examples and pass all four validation/freshness checks.
measurements.result: The generated corpus has zero refused examples and all four validation/freshness checks pass.

outcome: The targeted routing correction is complete and reviewed. The historical task-planning recommendation remains failed; developer-only read-only progress visibility is the next permitted package. Execution rollout remains blocked.
lessons: A hypothetical auxiliary verb alone does not establish a prediction task.
Exercise both routing and the caller that interprets a free-text answer as a user choice.
Preserve an explicit choice before invoking inference.
Do not treat a regression fix as independent benchmark evidence.
Separate read-only developer visibility from execution rollout.
risks: Conditional questions with no other recognized evidence may need clarification without a model.
Existing saved readings are not migrated automatically.
Model-assisted proposed-graph admission and independent evaluation remain unresolved.
The broader six-choice audit is not completed by this narrow correction.
